chunks: Say: "I am not a new Messenger to come, nor do I know what is to be done to me or you. I only follow what is revealed to me. My duty is only to warn you clearly."

key_terms.بِدْعاً: a new thing / innovation / first of its kind

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran mean when it says the Prophet is not a 'new' creation among the messengers?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse (46:9) underscores the Prophet's human nature and reliance on wahy, countering claims of his divinity or independent knowledge of the unseen. It highlights his role as a clear warner (nathir) who conveys the message without adding personal innovation, affirming the continuity of prophethood. This reinforces the Shia understanding of the Prophet's infallibility in transmission while maintaining his distinct human status.
